..Title
Resolution to Approve a Professional Services Agreement with Emergent Health Partners for Fire Dispatch Services and Appropriate Funding ($210,429.00) (8 Votes Required)
..Memorandum
Emergent Health Partners (EHP) has provided the City with fire dispatch services since July 1, 2009.  This services agreement is for EHP to provide fire department dispatching services for FY2027.  The City continues to explore alternatives for dispatch service providers; however, there are no other viable options at this time. 

EHP complies with the City's Non-Discrimination and Living Wage ordinances. 

Budget/Fiscal Impact: This contract includes a 17% increase in cost which was not anticipated in the FY 2027 budget.  It is being requested that the additional cost of the contract be appropriated to the Fire Department expenditure budget from the fund balance of the General Fund in the amount of $31,840.00.
..Staff
Prepared by:  	Chantel Jackson, Administrative Manager, Fire
Reviewed by: 	Mike Kennedy, Fire Chief
Approved by: 	Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, EHP has provided dispatching services for the Ann Arbor Fire Department since July 1, 2009; and

Whereas, The City of Ann Arbor continues to explore a unified public safety dispatch solution; however, there are no other viable options at this time;

RESOLVED, That City Council approves a Professional Services Agreement with Emergent Health Partners for Fire Communications and Dispatch Services in the amount of $210,429.00 for FY2027 ("Agreement");

RESOLVED, That City Council appropriates $31,840.00 to the FY 2027 General Fund Fire Department expenditure budget from the General Fund fund balance;

RESOLVED, That the Mayor and City Clerk are authorized to sign the Agreement after approval as to substance by the City Administrator and approval as to form by the City Attorney; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator is authorized to take all appropriate actions to implement this resolution, including signing all necessary documents and sub-agreements, and termination of the Agreement per its terms if deemed necessary.
